item.tib: rgyal yum kun gsal byams ma chen mo'i rtsa ba sngags bstod nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i 'grel ba mu tig mdzes pa'i chun 'phyang
item.coloph: ces rgyal yum kun gsal byams ma chen mo'i rtsa ba sngags bstod nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i 'grel ba mu tig mdzes pa'i chun 'phyang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ thos bsam gyi bag chags srab cing shes bya'i blo gros kyi mig dkyus thung bya ba byed pa ni/ bzhad bgad kyi gnas las ci zhig ste/ 'on kyang 'gran bral grub pa'i dbang phyug mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs khro sprul g.yung drung mthong grol mchog nas bkas nan bskul spyi bor yang yang phebs (phab) pa dang / lhag par bka' drin mtshungs med shar rdza'i rnal 'byor mang ga'i mtshan can nas 'di ltar bgyis na legs tshul gyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi gnang rtsol byung ba yid la bcing bzhin/ nye bar mchog gzigs dam pa rtogs ldan bstan 'dzin ye shes nas bka' nan gsungs 'phros 'phral du pheb (phab) par brten nas/ rang bzo dang rtogs 'dod kyi dri ma'i (mas) ma sbag par/ kun gsal rgyas pa'i rgyud 'bum sgrub thabs rnams kyi lung gis nges gsal byas/ sa bcad rnam pa gsum gyi khong (khongs) su drangs ba'i 'bru 'grel go sla gtso ru ston nas gab sbas med par lhag bsam dag pas bkod pa/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i nang tshan cho 'phrul ces pa shing pho 'brug gi lo'i cho 'phrul wa (zla) ba'i dkar phyogs su/ rdza stod khrom bzang bkra shis rdzong gi 'dus gnas bde chen phun tshogs gling du 'di nyid la dad pa brtan por thob cing dbang lung legs par rdzogs pa'i snyoms las pa/ khro rigs yid bzhin dbang rgyal du 'bod pas bgyis pa shes bya'i blo gros kyi mig dkyus thung ba bdag 'dras bstan pa'i rgyan dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen por nus pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
